answer: The yarrow test I would run is Federated notary public commission with notaries society attestation: a commission the society renews after seal audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a commission the society renews after seal audits takes calendar time as well as money — and the tide is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Do the arithmetic for a hundred clones: a hundred proofs, each with its own paperwork, hardware, or history, and the raven is a budget no epoch payout can repay.
